paragraphs.text:
Your  party  moves  carefully  along  the  trail  of  the  departing 
Tsuut’ina outcasts. To track these practiced woodsmen will not 
be easy.

Make a Stealth roll for the least-stealthy member of your party: if 
successful, go to 587; if not, go to 570.
